description: To deliver a paid origin tool, pass origin_tool with origin_arguments and idempotency_key; that call does not charge again. If the client schema has no origin_tool, pass method tool:<origin_tool> on an already-paid offer and put the origin arguments as a JSON object in confirmation. Use this only after the person agrees to pay. It is the only tool that spends on Sepolia. prepare_checkout never pays, and get_receipt never charges. Input: offer_id, the confirmation from prepare_checkout, and confirm=true. Pass confirm=false to decline. Pass method pix for the test-only Pix option. Pass simulate true with method pix to mark that test paid and deliver the test content in this call. That path does not sign a chain transaction and does not spend USDC. Omit method, or pass x402, for Sepolia. A caller with a wallet can pay with a direct x402 HTTP POST to the seller resource, JSON-RPC tools/call, headers x-azpay-offer-id and payment-signature. GET is not priced. The same response also includes next_action with the hosted checkout URL. After you give that link, tell the person to come back and say "I paid". When they do, call get_checkout_status with offer_id and, if checkout_state is paid, immediately call pay_and_access or get_receipt with origin_tool and origin_arguments to deliver the tool result. Optional origin_tool and origin_arguments run one paid origin tool after payment and consume one unit only when the origin succeeds. Optional idempotency_key repeats a successful delivery without consuming again. A failed origin call does not consume a unit, and the same key can be tried again. Optional list_origin_tools lists origin tools, including inputSchema, and does not consume a unit. Public callers get x402 payment requirements and the hosted checkout together. Sponsored signing runs only for the owner key on Sepolia testnet.

confirm.description: True only after the person agrees to pay. False declines and spends nothing.

confirmation.description: Single-use confirmation returned by prepare_checkout. Required when confirm is true. When method is tool:<origin_tool>, a JSON object in this string is the origin arguments. Any other value means empty arguments. Values are not logged.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Repeat the same origin_tool delivery without consuming another unit.

list_origin_tools.description: Optional. When true and origin_tool is omitted, list the origin tools and do not consume a unit.

method.description: Optional. Pass pix for the test-only Pix option. Pass hosted_checkout to receive the browser checkout URL. Omit it, or pass x402, for the Sepolia test payment. On an already-paid offer, pass tool:<origin_tool> to deliver that origin tool. This does not charge again.

offer_id.description: Accepted offer id from negotiate_price or prepare_checkout.

origin_arguments.description: Optional object of arguments for origin_tool. Values are not logged.

origin_tool.description: Optional. After the order is paid, call this origin tool and consume one unit.

simulate.description: Optional. With method pix in test mode, true marks the Pix test paid and delivers the test content in this call. Ignored for x402. Defaults to false.
